asr.full_text: Bitcoin cryptocurrency has established itself the most expensive value in the world only in one trading session has been raised to 700 dollars per US dollar. That is approximately 20,000 rubles for one virtual coin. It is difficult to believe that a year ago this currency about 20 000 rubles each. It's hard to believe but in less than a year ago that currency cost less than $13. Today a Bitcoin economy that mainly represents the online sector of the online services market in its most different legal level recently grew up to $8 billion. Apparently, this increase will to be staying. On last Monday the US Senate Commission at it's first meeting on the cryptoeconomics issue explicitly stated No execution is allowed, it's a good deal. As they said on the official Bitcoin statistics website, Senate hearings turned to the festival of love. Indeed, the experts were warmly talking about BitCoin and its like. The Vice Attorney prosecutor of the US promised that despite the many criminal cases involving bitcoin, the currency has no particular claims. On the contrary, it is capable of performing a major role in the optimization of the world's economy. The main point, is that is easier to track out how, where, and who is spending it than using an ordinary cash, which has remained the main financial tool of criminality. The representative of the Federal Reserve System, Ben Bernanke, directed his appeal to the Senate himself . He wrote that Bitcoin has great potential if modern technologies are able to create a fast and safe payment system based on it. In general, what happens now with the main money-to-go is amazing, because just one month ago it was predicted to get an exit ban on the same people, who were singing to it the deframbo in Senat. when bitcoin was created, nobody was taking it seriously, in fact, it was a toy currency, similar to what users use on all kinds of online games. no one took a serious approach to BitCoin. In fact, it was actually a toy currency, something similar to what users of online games buy and use. However, it soon turned out that it is quite safe and dangerous to pay with Bitcoin such as at Silk Road auction, which was open until recently in a shady web-channel, net TOR. For virtual money, you could buy drugs, weapons and even pay services of the mercenary murderer. It is TOR, who is guilty, that bitcoin increased so sharply. In August, after of the scandal with the expose of Edward Snowdon, when it turned out that, in usual Internet, the user was under close view of the special services, crowds of those who did not like them rushed to underground. The number of permanent TOR inhabitants In just a couple of weeks, the number of regular TOR residents went up almost twice – from 600 thousand to more than one million. All in all, the Bitcoin exchange rate has skyrocketed with more and more TOR customers. Basically, it became the main target for the CIA to take control of. As a consequence, Silk Road and the closing of the trading space. When it happened, it seemed that bitcoin itself would fall next. But in fact the Fed decided to give up such a serious financial instrument. And leave it for some purposes. The fact is that bitcoin is a payment system that, unlike PayPal, does not have adherence to paper money. It makes up its own money. It is only business is in making money and gold. Its only business in making money. And its price is proportional to the amount it produces. As Bitcoin increases, the more it spends it on Bitcoin. As Bitcoin increases, the more it spends it on Bitcoin. Bitcoin generates an algorithm for calculating currencies. Bitcoin generates an algorithm for calculating currencies. It will draw these data and convert them into a single number, at certain computing powers. It was invented by some human or a group of characters under the pseudonym Satoshi Nakamoto. The person is mythical, invented and disappeared. Whether he was in reality, no one knows. The next development and support of the program included quite real individuals. The Bitcoin algorithm is such that the more Bitcoins in turnover, the less they're will spend in time . Production is gradually heading for zero and in the foreseeable future, will completely cease. Each coin has its own unique code. It is not able to be copied like the golden bars. It is able to just move from hand to hand. It's practically impossible to fake Bitcoin. The payment system identifies it as allure. When Bitcoin is available to the public, it becomes the rule saver. This is a condition, of course, but in fact, gold too has attracted at one point it as beautiful metal, without any special characteristics.

annotation.contextual_rationale: The supplied description separately promotes OneCoin as a once-in-a-lifetime business opportunity, while the title and sampled report content present a news-style segment focused on Bitcoin rather than an explicit OneCoin enrollment or purchase pitch. The ASR discusses Bitcoin’s price, payment system, and Silk Road association as explanatory subject matter; these observations do not establish a promised future return, a required financial contribution, or a transaction flow for viewers. The promotional description is evidence of a favorable opportunity claim, but the available inputs do not establish how viewers would participate in OneCoin or connect that promotion to the Bitcoin reporting, so the specific solicitation mechanism remains unclear.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 is the best-grounded supplied subtype because the source presents Bitcoin as a token whose exchange rate and reported value increased, including a reported rise from less than $13 and a description that the exchange rate 'has skyrocketed.' The supplied evidence does not show a viewer purchase or capital contribution, so the subtype is supported by the token-appreciation relationship rather than an observed solicitation pathway.
